iconography.finding: There is no icon library or iconography spec in the repository. logo/favicon.svg and logo/app-icon.svg are logo variants. index.html contains inline demo icons used only as board illustrations. OWNERSHIP lists 'icon treatment' as a responsibility, but no source exists.
options: owned guidance (a future doc in this repo)
future asset family (new directory, new BK item)
iconography.decision: unresolved; handed to BK-02 / consumer owners. Do not claim an icon system exists.
iconography.handoff: Consumer repositories currently own any UI icons they ship; their inventory is outside this repository.

external_findings.finding: docs/architecture/OWNERSHIP.md line 3 says the repository is private (verified 2026-10-10). Live GitHub metadata on 2026-10-12 reports visibility PUBLIC (gh repo view). The OWNERSHIP line is stale; it is a BK-07-owned governance doc and is not edited here.
external_findings.evidence: gh repo view Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/brand-kit --json visibility on 2026-10-12

external_findings.finding: PR #3 (open, not merged) repoints ticket-studio links to getticketstub.com/docs/studio/ and proposes 'always on paper'. external_findings.handoff: Merge getticketstub.com#4/#20 first, then PR #3; direction change needs a BK-02 decision record.
